breadcrumbs.name: RFID Race Timing Tags — Sub-second Precision For Running, Triathlon & Cycling Events

summary: UHF RFID race timing tags attach to bib numbers, shoes or bicycles to provide automated split and finish timing for road races, triathlons, cycling events and obstacle courses. Timing mats at start, split and finish lines read each participant's tag, delivering chip-time results accurate to hundredths of a second.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
860-960 MHz (UHF) — standard for modern race timing
